predecessors.name: Tovata Confederacy
predecessors.text: Ma'afu's Tovata, 'covering most of northern and eastern Fiji' (Lau, Cakaudrove, Bua, Macuata)

successors.name: British Colonial Empire
successors.text: the whole kingdom, ceded by the Deed of Cession of 10 October 1874 and organised as the Colony of Fiji

ledger.x: 1871: Cakobau is proclaimed Tui Viti, King of Fiji, at Levuka.
1871: Ma'afu's northern and eastern confederacy comes under the Fijian crown.

certainty.note: An island kingdom: the coasts are sharp, but the kingdom's writ in the Viti Levu highlands and the standing of Ma'afu's north and east were unsettled throughout; no treaty or survey line existed before the cession.
